description: Every place the academic-writer PLUGIN version is written. Single source of truth for scripts/version-sync.py, the release workflow's bump step, and tests/test_version_consistency.py. Adding a new manifest that carries the plugin version means adding it here — the test's discovery guard fails the suite otherwise. Registered before 0.7.0: features.json had silently drifted to 0.5.0 while everything else said 0.6.3, because the release workflow's bump step wrote only three of the six locations and check-version-consistency.sh deliberately scoped itself to one pair.

locations.why: npm package identity; the bump step reads this as CURRENT
BUILT and committed; regenerated by npm run build, drifted in the v0.6.1 incident
feature-coverage checklist; drifted 0.5.0 -> unnoticed for two releases
